scope: frontend guard and public-route fallback logic

checks.evidence: PublicOnly sets hasTimedOut after 5000ms while status is checking and then renders children, which lets the login form render.
The checking spinner is no longer the terminal branch; timed-out checking state renders public content.
AuthGuard sets shouldRenderShell for authenticated or checking plus timed-out status, then returns children.
Unauthenticated status still redirects to /login and renders LoginScreen as a visible fallback.
Every AuthGuard status branch returns visible UI: error panel, children shell, LoginScreen, or bounded checking indicator.
